ABOUT

A creative learner with a product mindset.

I am pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science & Business Systems at Techno Main Salt Lake, Kolkata (2024–Present). My creative work focuses on visual storytelling, composition, color harmony, typography and product mockup design.

I am especially interested in learning how illustration becomes a finished consumer product—from choosing a strong scene and visual hierarchy to preparing artwork that works on a physical format.
